content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: An XML namespace is identified by its namespace name (commonly a URI). A prefix is a local alias bound by xmlns; the prefix spelling is not the identity. An unprefixed attribute does not inherit the default element namespace.

content_blocks.title: Connect the subtopics

content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: Namespace URIs and Namespace Identity
content_blocks.expected_output: The two item elements use different namespace names even though both local names are item. Prefix spelling is only an alias for the namespace URI.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Inspect this example as text. Run it only in a processor that supports the shown language/version; the standard CodeLeaf playground previews HTML/CSS/JavaScript only and does not execute XML, XSD, XPath, XSLT, XQuery, Python, or SQL. When querying namespaced XML, bind a prefix in the XPath/XSLT host context and use that prefix in expressions. Two prefixes bound to the same namespace URI refer to the same expanded names.
